description: This Java source file defines a ContentProvider named FeedProvider for managing access to a feed database, including URI matching, CRUD operations, and SQLite database helper class.

classes.name: FeedProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider implementation for accessing feed entries stored in an SQLite database.

classes.name: FeedProvider.FeedDatabase
classes.description: SQLiteOpenHelper subclass managing the creation and upgrade of the feed database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper when the provider is created.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for the given URI.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a database query based on the URI, returning matching entries.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into the database for the given URI.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes entries from the database based on the URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates entries in the database based on the URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: FeedDatabase (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs the SQLiteOpenHelper for managing the feed database.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping and recreating the table.
